# Data & Sync Requirements Checklist: Cards — user-defined order + richer colour choice

**Purpose**: Validate that the persistence, cross-device sync and upgrade requirements for the new card position and custom colour are complete, unambiguous and verifiable before planning
**Created**: 2026-09-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Position Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK022 Is the position of a card specified unambiguously — a relative order among cards, or an absolute index each card carries? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for what happens to the order when a card is deleted, so no undefined gap remains? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Are the archived-card ordering requirements complete — their order among themselves and their position on restore? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for the number of cards the ordering must handle without the row or the sync degrading? [Gap, Non-Functional]

## Upgrade & Migration Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 Is "the order the app showed before the upgrade" defined concretely enough to be reproduced, rather than assumed? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the no-repainting requirement measurable — exactly what must be identical before and after the upgrade? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements defined for reading data written by the previous app version, where no position and no custom colour exist? [Gap, Recovery]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for the reverse direction — data written by this version being read by the older version still installed on the other device? [Gap, Recovery]
- [ ] CHK030 Are rollback or failure requirements defined for the local data upgrade itself? [Gap, Recovery]

## Sync & Conflict Requirements

- [ ] CHK031 Is the conflict rule for two concurrent reorders stated precisely enough that one outcome can be predicted and verified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements defined for a merge where one device knows a card the other does not, so the merged order stays complete? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK033 Is it specified whether a reorder on its own counts as a change that must trigger a sync? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK034 Are the offline requirements stated for reordering as explicitly as for editing a card? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the requirement that no card is lost or duplicated by a merge expressed as a checkable property? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003]

## Colour Data Requirements

- [ ] CHK036 Are validation requirements defined for a colour value that is not a usable colour at all, e.g. from a corrupted snapshot? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the nearest-calendar-colour rule specified well enough to give a deterministic, testable result for any colour? [Measurability, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK038 Are requirements defined for calendar events that already exist when a card colour changes — updated, or left as they are? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK039 Are the requirements for a legacy colour outside the offered set consistent with the requirements for a custom colour? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK028, CHK029, CHK030, CHK033 and CHK038 are gaps the spec never addressed; CHK026, CHK031 and CHK037 are places where the spec states an intention that is not yet verifiable
